result.summary: This PR adds a new kernel API function, btck_transaction_get_version, exposing CTransaction::version so external consumers of libbitcoinkernel can read a transaction's version field without parsing raw serialized bytes. It mirrors the pattern of two recently merged sibling PRs (#36194 header Merkle root, #36207 wtxid accessor) and includes a corresponding wrapper method and unit test covering several version values including edge cases.
result.problem: Clients using libbitcoinkernel currently cannot read a transaction's version field without manually slicing serialized transaction bytes, which is inconvenient and easy to get wrong. This affects any external tool or library built on the kernel API that needs transaction metadata.

It is a small (29-line), self-contained follow-up to two recently merged sibling accessor PRs (#36194, #36207), completing a pattern of transaction accessor exposure in the kernel API.
